sentences.en: Objective: These experiments were designed to examine the effect of television watching on habituation of ingestive behavior in children.

sentences.en: Some major positive sIgE for children with allergic diseases were house dust mite, house dust, artemisia pollen and tobacco mould, and ingestive allergen, such as egg white, milk, peanut and soybean.
